confidence_notes: Beer, cappuccino and inexpensive-meal figures are based on crowd-sourced Brno data from MyLifeElsewhere (2026): local beer about CZK 55-57, cappuccino about CZK 71-76 and an inexpensive meal about CZK 200. A national guide from Freenance gives similar ranges. No Brno-specific data was found for mid-range meals, cocktails or wine. These are model estimates scaled from beer and meal prices and known Czech price ratios, so they are less certain. All accommodation anchors are general-knowledge model estimates, not checks of live listings. They reflect July peak-season demand and how cheap Brno is compared with Prague. The FX figure is the RBA 4pm rate for 18 Nov 2026. Search results showed it on a secondary site citing RBA data, alongside the official RBA exchange-rate page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Brno is the Czech Republic's second city. Prices are calibrated as clearly below Prague and broadly similar to Ostrava, Plzen and mid-sized Central European cities such as Bratislava or Krakow.
